newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran and Turkmenistan sign cooperation pacts.
newsitem.headline: Iran and Turkmenistan sign cooperation pacts.

text.p: Iran and Turkmenistan have signed agreements to boost cooperation in commerce, railways, dam building and environmental protection, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported.

Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani and visiting Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov issued a joint statement underscoring strong ties between the two countries, the agency said late on Thursday.
The two sides agreed to form working committees to address issues including politics, agriculture, commerce banking and telecommunications.
Another key issue under discussion was the transportation of Turkmen gas to Turkey across Iran.
The new route of Turkmen gas exports will run separately from the joint Turkmen-Irani Korpedzhe-Kurt-Kuyi pipeline which is currently being built.
Rafsanjani and Niyazov also expressed concern over continuing bloodshed in Afghanistan and called on Afghan factions to negotiate a political solution.
